import ast, io, sys, tokenize
src = open("utils.py", encoding="utf-8").read()
has_comment = any(t.type == tokenize.COMMENT for t in tokenize.generate_tokens(io.StringIO(src).readline))
tree = ast.parse(src)
has_doc = any(isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name == "clamp" and ast.get_docstring(n) for n in ast.walk(tree))
sys.exit(0 if has_comment or has_doc else 1)
